main_text.p: Et convolventur, Jes.34.4. Futur. יִגַּל [?] Et devolvetur; i.e. Decurret, fluet, Amos 5.24. Pih.Praeter. ex geminata prima radicali; וְגִלְגַּלְתִּיךָ [?] Et devolvam te, Jer.51.25. Pyh. Partic.foem. מְגֹלָּלָה [?] Volutatum, Jes.9.5. Hiph. Futur. וַיַּגַּל [?] Ut devolveret, Gen.29.10. Hithp. Praeter. הִתְגַּלְגֵּל [?] Devolvunt fese, Job.30.14. Partic. מִתְגּוֹלֵל [?] Volutabat fese, 2.Sam.20.12. Infin. לְהִתְגַּלֵּל [?] Ut volutetur, Gen.43.18.

גּוֹל [?] m. Devolutus, Psal.22.9. Quidam loco Participii praesentis גָּלַל [?] positum existimant, Devolvens est, Devolvit, scil. vel se, vel res aut vias tuas, juxta id: Devolve super Dominum viam tuam, Psal.37.5.

גַּל [?] m. Cumulus, Acervus, quasi Convolutionem dicas, Gen.31.46. Item Scaturigo, à Revolutione aquæ, Cant.4. v.12. עַל־גַּל [?] Juxta scaturiginem, Job.8.17. Plural. גַּלִּים [?] Acervi, Hos.12.11. 2.Reg.19.25. Item Fluctus, ab aquarum Convolutione, Zach.10.11. Constr. גַּלֵּי הַיָּם [?] Sicut fluctus maris, Jesa.48.18. Aff. גַּלֶּיךָ [?] Fluctuum tuorum, Job.38.11.

גַּלָּה [?] f. Lecythus, Lenticula: מִימִין הַגַּלָּה [?] A dextris lecythi, Zach.4.3. Constr. גִּלַּת הַזָּהָב [?] Lecythus auri, Eccl.12.6. Aff. וּגְלָּתָהּ [?] Et lecythus ejus, Zach.4.2. pro גִּלָּתָהּ [?]: vide similem in עֶרֶם [?] inter Nomina: Plural. גִּלּוֹת [?] Scaturigines, Jos.15.9. גִּלּוֹת [?] Orbes, 1.Reg.7.41.

גִּלָּיוֹן [?] m. Volumen, Liber, qui antiquitus, in longum descriptus, Convolvebatur, ut hodiè Liber Legis in Synagogis Judæorum: vel, si deducatur à גלה [?], quia ignota Revelat: גִּלָּיוֹן גָּדוֹל [?] Volumen magnum, Jesa.8.1.

גַּלַּל [?] m. Stercus, à Convolutione, 1.Reg.14.10. Aff. גִּלֻּלָיו [?] Sicut stercus ipsius, Job.20.7. Plural. גִּלֻּלִים [?] Veluti stercora, Soph.1.17. Constr. תַּחַת גִּלֵּי הָאָדָם [?] Pro stercoribus humanis, Ezech.4.15.
גָּלָל [?] masc. Chald. Devolutio: אֶבֶן גְּלָל [?] Lapis devolu-

page.notes: Hebrew pointing and letters are read from a small scan and are doubtful throughout; each uncertain Hebrew form carries [?]. The Latin "Jef." and "Pfal." in the citations are long-s forms; written as Jes. and Psal. Headword "גַּל" in the running head is uncertain. Last line ends mid-word with a printed hyphen and continues on the next page. Watermark at lower right not transcribed.
